answer_1.quote: The overall result is an end-to-end model, AudioChatLlama, that can perform text/speech-to-response generation and utilize prior context in a conversation to guide the model in its reasoning.
answer_1.outputs: text responses to speech or text input, including dialogue, summaries, and translations

answer_2.quote: We measure the perplexity of the speech-prompted LLM on the responses generated by the text-prompted LLM.

answer_4.quote: we conducted a human evaluation to compare the quality of the generated response between AudioChatLlama and the best-performing cascaded baseline on the TriviaQA-TTS test set.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators judge the response quality by comparing with reference answers.
